memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's --no-build flag (RUN_BUILD=0) skips exactly the checks that shell out to `lake env lean`/`lake build`/`lake exe` (C1, C2, C6's compile-check half, C14's #print-axioms half, C16, C24, C25, C36b) while leaving every content/structural check running (C3-C5, C7-C9, C11, C15, C36a, etc.) unaffected. This makes `bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --no-build` a genuinely safe lightweight check under host memory pressure that forbids a `lake build`-class command: it can confirm C15 (every theorem-index row anchored at its declaration) and C36a (every certificate class has a pinned witness) without touching the Lean elaborator at all, which is exactly the verification a ledger-row-only phase (Verification Tier: prose/local without a term-level proof change) needs.
